# All Tools Together

Updated: 2026-11-17 (maintained content revision)

> 355 free tools across 23 categories. Tools marked local process on the device; advanced document conversion, writing services and URL shortening use a backend when available. Currency conversion fetches external rates. No professional review or guaranteed accuracy is implied.

## Mortgage Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/mortgage-calculator

See your monthly payment, total interest, and PMI risk for any home loan.

Search focus: mortgage calculator; home loan calculator; monthly mortgage payment; pmi calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Home price ($), Down payment ($), Interest rate (%), Loan term (yrs), Property tax (yearly, optional) ($), Home insurance (yearly, optional) ($).

Method: The payment uses the standard amortization formula M = P·r(1+r)ⁿ / ((1+r)ⁿ − 1), where P is the loan amount, r the monthly rate, and n the number of monthly payments. If your loan-to-value ratio is above 80%, the tool flags that private mortgage insurance (PMI) is usually required.

## Loan Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/loan-calculator

Monthly payment, total interest, and total cost for any fixed-rate loan.

Search focus: loan calculator; loan payment calculator; emi calculator; personal loan calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Loan amount ($), Annual interest rate (%), Term (yrs).

Method: It applies the amortization formula used by banks worldwide. Each payment covers that month's interest first; the remainder reduces principal, which is why early payments are interest-heavy.

## Auto Loan Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/auto-loan-calculator

Car payment including sales tax, trade-in value, and dealer fees.

Search focus: auto loan calculator; car loan calculator; car payment calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Vehicle price ($), Cash down ($), Trade-in value ($), Sales tax (%), Fees (title, doc…) ($), APR (%), Term (mo).

Method: Amount financed = price + tax + fees − down payment − trade-in, then the standard amortization formula computes the payment. Tax is applied to the price minus trade-in, the rule in most US states (a few differ — check yours).

## Compound Interest Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/compound-interest-calculator

Project how savings grow with compounding and regular contributions.

Search focus: compound interest calculator; investment growth calculator; compound interest formula
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Starting amount ($), Annual rate (%), Years (yrs), Compounding, Contribution per period ($).

Method: Future value = P(1+r/n)ⁿᵗ for the lump sum, plus PMT·((1+r/n)ⁿᵗ−1)/(r/n) for end-of-period contributions. Note the contribution is per compounding period — with monthly compounding, it is a monthly deposit.

## Simple Interest Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/simple-interest-calculator

I = P × R × T, computed instantly with the total repayment amount.

Search focus: simple interest calculator; simple interest formula; interest earned
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Principal ($), Annual rate (%), Time (yrs).

Method: Interest = Principal × annual rate × years. Unlike compound interest, the base never grows — simple interest is common for short-term loans and some bonds.

## Savings Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/savings-calculator

How your balance grows with monthly deposits at a given APY.

Search focus: savings calculator; savings goal calculator; high yield savings calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Starting balance ($), Monthly deposit ($), APY (%), Years (yrs).

Method: It compounds the balance monthly and adds your deposit each month — the same future-value-of-a-series math banks use. The split between your deposits and earned interest is shown separately.

## ROI Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/roi-calculator

Return on investment as a percentage, plus annualized ROI.

Search focus: roi calculator; return on investment calculator; annualized roi
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Amount invested ($), Amount returned ($), Holding period (optional) (yrs).

Method: ROI = (returned − invested) / invested. Annualized ROI = (1 + ROI)^(1/years) − 1, which converts a multi-year gain into a per-year rate you can compare against other investments.

## Inflation Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/inflation-calculator

What today's money will cost — and buy — years from now.

Search focus: inflation calculator; purchasing power calculator; cpi calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Amount today ($), Average inflation rate (%), Years (yrs).

Method: Future cost = amount × (1 + i)ʸᵉᵃʳˢ. The default 3% approximates long-run averages in many developed economies — adjust it to model different scenarios.

## Credit Card Payoff Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/credit-card-payoff-calculator

How long to clear a card balance — and the interest it will cost.

Search focus: credit card payoff calculator; credit card interest calculator; debt free calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Card balance ($), APR (%), Monthly payment ($).

Method: Each month the simulator adds interest (balance × APR/12) and subtracts your payment, repeating until the balance reaches zero. If your payment doesn't even cover the monthly interest, it warns you the balance will never shrink.

## Salary Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/salary-calculator

Convert pay between hourly, weekly, monthly, and annual instantly.

Search focus: salary calculator; salary to hourly calculator; pay converter
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Pay amount ($), Per, Hours per week (h), Paid weeks per year (wk).

Method: Everything converts through the annual figure: annual = hourly × hours/week × weeks/year. Part-time hours or unpaid weeks change the picture significantly, so both are adjustable.

## Hourly to Salary Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/hourly-to-salary-calculator

Your annual salary from an hourly wage in one step.

Search focus: hourly to salary calculator; hourly to annual salary; wage converter
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Hourly rate ($), Hours per week (h), Weeks per year (wk).

Method: Annual = hourly rate × hours per week × weeks per year. At the default 40 hours and 52 weeks, a quick mental shortcut is hourly × 2,080.

## Tip Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/tip-calculator

Tip amount, total bill, and per-person split in one tap.

Search focus: tip calculator; tip and split calculator; restaurant bill calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Bill amount ($), Tip (%), Split between (ppl).

Method: Tip = bill × tip%; the total is split evenly across the group. Adjust the percentage for service quality or local custom.

## Debt-to-Income (DTI) Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/dti-calculator

Front-end and back-end DTI — the ratios lenders actually check.

Search focus: dti calculator; debt to income ratio calculator; mortgage dti
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Gross monthly income ($), Monthly housing payment ($), Other monthly debt payments ($).

Method: Front-end DTI = housing ÷ gross income. Back-end DTI = (housing + other debts) ÷ gross income. Conventional guidelines favor back-end ratios at or below 36%, with 43% a common ceiling for qualified mortgages.

## Down Payment Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/down-payment-calculator

Down payment amount, resulting loan size, and your LTV at a glance.

Search focus: down payment calculator; down payment percentage; house deposit calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Home price ($), Down payment (%).

Method: Down payment = price × percent. LTV = loan ÷ price. Above 80% LTV, conventional loans generally require private mortgage insurance until equity grows.

## Sales Tax Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/sales-tax-calculator

Add tax to a price — or extract the pre-tax price from a total.

Search focus: sales tax calculator; tax calculator; reverse sales tax
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Amount ($), Tax rate (%), Direction.

Method: Adding: total = price × (1 + rate). Extracting: pre-tax = total ÷ (1 + rate) — the reverse operation, useful for expense reports and bookkeeping.

## Refinance Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/refinance-calculator

Should you refinance? See the new payment, savings, and break-even point.

Search focus: refinance calculator; mortgage refinance calculator; refinance savings; break even mortgage
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Current loan balance ($), Current rate (%), Years remaining (yrs), New rate (%), New term (yrs), Closing costs ($).

Method: The tool amortizes both loans and subtracts the payments. Break-even = closing costs / monthly savings. If you sell or refinance again before break-even, the refi loses money even at a lower rate.

## Amortization Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/amortization-calculator

Monthly payment plus how each year splits between principal and interest.

Search focus: amortization calculator; amortization schedule; loan amortization
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Loan amount ($), Interest rate (%), Term (yrs).

Method: Each payment is fixed, but its makeup changes: interest = current balance x monthly rate, and the rest reduces principal. Early on the balance is large, so most of the payment is interest.

## 401(k) Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/401k-calculator

Project your 401(k) balance, including the full employer match.

Search focus: 401k calculator; 401k growth calculator; employer match
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Annual salary ($), Your contribution (%), Employer match rate (%), Match cap (% of salary) (%), Current 401(k) balance ($), Expected annual return (%), Years to retirement (yrs), Annual raise (%).

Method: Each year your contribution plus the employer match (match rate up to the cap) are added and grown by the expected return; salary increases by your raise. The match is the highest-return part of any retirement plan.

## Retirement Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/retirement-calculator

Will your savings last? Projected nest egg and the income it supports.

Search focus: retirement calculator; retirement savings calculator; will my money last
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Current age (yrs), Retirement age (yrs), Current savings ($), Monthly contribution ($), Expected annual return (%).

Method: Your balance compounds monthly with your contributions added each month until retirement. The 4 percent rule then estimates a sustainable annual withdrawal, a rough planning benchmark, not a guarantee.

## Roth IRA Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/roth-ira-calculator

Project tax-free Roth IRA growth to retirement.

Search focus: roth ira calculator; roth ira growth; tax free retirement
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Current age (yrs), Retirement age (yrs), Current balance ($), Annual contribution ($), Expected annual return (%).

Method: Contributions are made with after-tax money and compound at your expected return. Because you already paid tax going in, qualified withdrawals (age 59 and a half plus, account 5 plus years) come out tax-free.

## Investment Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/investment-calculator

Future value of a lump sum plus regular contributions.

Search focus: investment calculator; investment return calculator; future value
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Initial investment ($), Contribution per period ($), Contributions per year, Expected annual return (%), Years (yrs).

Method: The lump sum compounds at your expected return while each contribution compounds from the period it is added, the future-value-of-a-series calculation used across finance.

## Debt Snowball Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/debt-snowball-calculator

A payoff plan and debt-free date, snowball or avalanche.

Search focus: debt snowball calculator; debt payoff calculator; debt avalanche; pay off debt
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: One debt per line: balance, APR%, min payment, Extra monthly payment ($), Method.

Method: Every debt gets its minimum each month; the extra payment plus any freed-up minimums roll onto the target debt. Snowball targets the smallest balance first (quick wins); avalanche targets the highest rate first (least interest).

## Car Lease Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/car-lease-calculator

Monthly lease payment from price, residual, and money factor.

Search focus: car lease calculator; lease payment calculator; auto lease calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: MSRP (sticker price) ($), Negotiated price ($), Residual value (% of MSRP) (%), Money factor, Lease term (mo), Down payment ($), Sales tax (%).

Method: Depreciation = (capitalized cost - residual) / term. Finance charge = (cap cost + residual) x money factor. The payment is their sum plus tax. Multiply the money factor by 2400 to see its APR equivalent.

## Budget Calculator (50/30/20)

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/budget-calculator

Split your income into needs, wants, and savings with the 50/30/20 rule.

Search focus: budget calculator; 50 30 20 budget; monthly budget calculator; personal finance planner
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Monthly after-tax income ($).

Method: The rule allocates 50 percent of after-tax income to needs (housing, food, utilities), 30 percent to wants, and 20 percent to savings and extra debt payments. It is a starting template you can adjust to your costs.

## Car Payment Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/car-payment-calculator

Find the vehicle price a target monthly payment can afford.

Search focus: car payment calculator; car affordability calculator; auto finance calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Target monthly payment ($), Interest rate (APR) (%), Loan term (mo), Down payment ($).

Method: The tool reverses the loan formula: given a payment, rate, and term, it solves for the financed principal, then adds your down payment to get the affordable sticker price.

## APR Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/apr-calculator

Find the true APR of a loan once fees are included.

Search focus: apr calculator; true apr calculator; annual percentage rate
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Loan amount ($), Nominal interest rate (%), Term (mo), Upfront fees ($).

Method: The monthly payment is computed from the nominal rate, but the fees reduce the cash you actually receive. The tool solves for the rate that equates those payments to the net amount, giving the true APR.

## Discount Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/discount-calculator

Final sale price and savings, including stacked discounts.

Search focus: discount calculator; percent off calculator; sale price calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Original price ($), Discount (%), Extra discount (optional) (%).

Method: The first discount comes off the original price; any extra discount applies to that already-reduced amount, not the original — which is why stacked percentages never simply add up.

## Net Worth Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/net-worth-calculator

Add up assets and subtract liabilities to find your net worth.

Search focus: net worth calculator; net worth tracker; assets and liabilities
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Cash & savings ($), Investments & retirement ($), Property & vehicles ($), Other assets ($), Mortgage balance ($), Loans (auto, student) ($), Credit card debt ($).

Method: Net worth = total assets - total liabilities. Track it over time; a rising number means you are building wealth, regardless of income.

## Mortgage Payoff Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/mortgage-payoff-calculator

See how extra payments cut years and interest off your mortgage.

Search focus: mortgage payoff calculator; extra mortgage payment calculator; pay off mortgage early
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Current balance ($), Interest rate (%), Years remaining (yrs), Extra monthly payment ($).

Method: The tool simulates your payoff month by month, applying the extra amount entirely to principal. Because interest is charged on the remaining balance, every extra dollar compounds into future savings.

## CD Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/cd-calculator

Maturity value and APY for a certificate of deposit.

Search focus: cd calculator; certificate of deposit calculator; cd interest calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Deposit amount ($), Interest rate (%), Term (yrs), Compounding.

Method: The deposit compounds at the stated rate and frequency. APY expresses the true yearly return including compounding, which is always slightly higher than the nominal rate.

## Future Value Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/future-value-calculator

What a sum today will grow to at a given rate.

Search focus: future value calculator; fv calculator; time value of money
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Present amount ($), Annual growth rate (%), Years (yrs).

Method: Future value = present value x (1 + rate)^years. It is the core of compound growth: time and rate together drive the result.

## Present Value Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/present-value-calculator

What a future sum is worth in today's money.

Search focus: present value calculator; pv calculator; discounted cash flow
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Future amount ($), Discount rate (%), Years from now (yrs).

Method: Present value = future value / (1 + rate)^years. The discount rate reflects the return you could earn elsewhere, so future money is worth less today.

## Annuity Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/annuity-calculator

Present and future value of a stream of regular payments.

Search focus: annuity calculator; annuity payment calculator; present value of annuity
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Payment per month ($), Annual interest rate (%), Years (yrs).

Method: Future value sums each payment compounded to the end; present value discounts each payment back to today. Both use the standard annuity formulas with monthly compounding.

## Break-Even Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/break-even-calculator

Units and revenue needed to cover your costs.

Search focus: break even calculator; break even analysis; business break even
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Fixed costs ($), Price per unit ($), Variable cost per unit ($).

Method: Break-even units = fixed costs / (price - variable cost per unit). The denominator is the contribution margin: how much each sale contributes toward fixed costs and profit.

## Profit Margin Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/profit-margin-calculator

Profit margin and markup from cost and selling price.

Search focus: profit margin calculator; margin calculator; gross margin
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Cost ($), Selling price ($).

Method: Margin = profit / selling price; markup = profit / cost. The same dollar profit gives a smaller margin percentage than markup percentage, since the denominators differ.

## Markup Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/markup-calculator

Selling price and profit from cost and markup percentage.

Search focus: markup calculator; markup percentage calculator; retail pricing calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Cost ($), Markup (%).

Method: Selling price = cost x (1 + markup%). The tool also converts the markup into the equivalent profit margin, which is always the smaller number.

## Commission Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/commission-calculator

Total pay from a commission rate, sales, and base salary.

Search focus: commission calculator; sales commission calculator; commission earnings
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Total sales ($), Commission rate (%), Base pay ($).

Method: Commission = sales x rate. Total pay adds your base salary. The tool keeps the two separate so you can see each component.

## Overtime Pay Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/overtime-calculator

Total pay including overtime at a chosen multiplier.

Search focus: overtime calculator; overtime pay calculator; time and a half calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Hourly rate ($), Regular hours (h), Overtime hours (h), Overtime multiplier.

Method: Regular pay = rate x regular hours. Overtime pay = overtime hours x rate x multiplier (1.5 for time-and-a-half). The total combines both.

## BMI Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/bmi-calculator

Body mass index, WHO category, and your healthy weight range.

Search focus: bmi calculator; body mass index calculator; check bmi
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Weight, Weight unit, Height, Height unit.

Method: BMI = weight(kg) ÷ height(m)². Categories: under 18.5 underweight, 18.5–24.9 normal, 25–29.9 overweight, 30+ obesity. BMI is a screening number, not a diagnosis — it doesn't distinguish muscle from fat.

## BMR Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/bmr-calculator

Calories your body burns at complete rest (Mifflin-St Jeor).

Search focus: bmr calculator; basal metabolic rate calculator; resting calories
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Sex, Age (yrs), Weight, Weight unit, Height, Height unit.

Method: Uses the Mifflin-St Jeor equation, the formula most validated in research: men 10w + 6.25h − 5a + 5; women 10w + 6.25h − 5a − 161 (w in kg, h in cm, a in years).

## TDEE Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/tdee-calculator

Total daily energy expenditure: BMR scaled by real activity.

Search focus: tdee calculator; total daily energy expenditure; maintenance calories
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Sex, Age (yrs), Weight, Weight unit, Height, Height unit, Activity level.

Method: TDEE = BMR (Mifflin-St Jeor) × an activity factor from 1.2 (sedentary) to 1.9 (twice-daily training). Eat at TDEE to maintain, below to lose, above to gain.

## Calorie Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/calorie-calculator

Daily calories to maintain, lose, or gain weight at a healthy pace.

Search focus: calorie calculator; daily calorie needs; calories to lose weight
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Sex, Age (yrs), Weight, Weight unit, Height, Height unit, Activity level.

Method: Maintenance = TDEE. A ~250 kcal daily deficit targets roughly 0.25 kg of loss per week; ~500 kcal targets 0.5 kg. Slow, steady deficits preserve muscle and are easier to sustain.

## Macro Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/macro-calculator

Grams of protein, carbs, and fat from your calorie target and split.

Search focus: macro calculator; macronutrient calculator; macros for cutting
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Daily calories (kcal), Protein (%), Carbs (%), Fat (%).

Method: Protein and carbs provide 4 kcal per gram; fat provides 9. Grams = (calories × percent) ÷ kcal-per-gram. The three percentages must total 100 — the tool checks.

## One Rep Max Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/one-rep-max-calculator

Estimate your 1RM from any set, with training percentages.

Search focus: one rep max calculator; 1rm calculator; lifting max
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Weight lifted, Reps completed (reps).

Method: Shows two validated estimates — Epley: w × (1 + reps/30); Brzycki: w × 36/(37 − reps) — plus 90% and 80% loads for strength and hypertrophy work.

## Running Pace Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/pace-calculator

Pace per km or mile from your distance and finish time.

Search focus: pace calculator; running pace calculator; marathon pace
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Distance (km or mi), Hours, Minutes, Seconds.

Method: Pace = total minutes ÷ distance, displayed as min:sec per unit. Speed (distance per hour) is shown alongside. Use the same unit for distance as you want for pace.

## Ideal Weight Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/ideal-weight-calculator

Ideal body weight by three clinical formulas, shown as a range.

Search focus: ideal weight calculator; ideal body weight; healthy weight range
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Sex, Height, Height unit.

Method: Each formula is a base weight plus an increment per inch over 5 feet (e.g. Devine: 50 kg + 2.3 kg/inch for men). They were developed for clinical dosing, which is why results differ slightly.

## Body Fat Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/body-fat-calculator

Estimate body fat percentage with the US Navy tape method.

Search focus: body fat calculator; body fat percentage calculator; navy body fat
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Sex, Height, Height unit, Neck circumference, Waist circumference, Hip circumference (women), Measurement unit.

Method: The US Navy formula uses log-based equations on neck, waist (and hip for women) relative to height. It is a quick estimate; methods like DEXA scans are more precise but far less accessible.

## Pregnancy Due Date Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/due-date-calculator

Your estimated due date and current pregnancy week from your last period.

Search focus: due date calculator; pregnancy due date calculator; baby due date
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: First day of last period (LMP), Average cycle length (days).

Method: Naegele's rule adds 280 days (40 weeks) to the first day of your last period, adjusted if your cycle differs from 28 days. It is an estimate; ultrasound dating from your provider is more accurate.

## Ovulation Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/ovulation-calculator

Estimate your fertile window and ovulation day.

Search focus: ovulation calculator; fertile window calculator; fertility calendar
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: First day of last period, Cycle length (days), Luteal phase length (days).

Method: Ovulation is estimated as the next period date minus the luteal phase length. The fertile window spans roughly the five days before ovulation through the day after, since sperm can survive several days.

## Sleep Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/sleep-calculator

Best bedtimes or wake times based on 90-minute sleep cycles.

Search focus: sleep calculator; sleep cycle calculator; bedtime calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: I want to, Time (24h, e.g. 07:00).

Method: Sleep runs in roughly 90-minute cycles. Working backward (or forward) in 90-minute blocks, plus about 15 minutes to fall asleep, lands your alarm at the lighter end of a cycle.

## Blood Alcohol (BAC) Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/bac-calculator

A rough blood alcohol estimate from drinks, weight, and time.

Search focus: bac calculator; blood alcohol calculator; drink limits
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Sex, Weight, Weight unit, Standard drinks, Hours since first drink (h).

Method: BAC = (alcohol grams / (body water grams)) x 100, minus roughly 0.015 per hour of metabolism. One US standard drink contains about 14 grams of alcohol. Many personal factors make this only an approximation.

## A1C Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/a1c-calculator

Convert between A1C and estimated average glucose.

Search focus: a1c calculator; a1c to glucose calculator; diabetes tracker
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Convert, Value (A1C % or mg/dL).

Method: The ADA formula relates them: eAG (mg/dL) = 28.7 x A1C - 46.7. A1C reflects average blood sugar over roughly the prior three months.

## Heart Rate Zone Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/heart-rate-zone-calculator

Your five training heart-rate zones from age and resting rate.

Search focus: heart rate zone calculator; target heart rate calculator; cardio zones
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Age (yrs), Resting heart rate (bpm).

Method: Maximum heart rate uses the Tanaka formula (208 - 0.7 x age), more accurate than the old 220 minus age. Zones are computed with the Karvonen method using your heart-rate reserve (max minus resting).

## Water Intake Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/water-intake-calculator

A daily hydration target from your weight and activity.

Search focus: water intake calculator; daily water calculator; hydration calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Weight, Weight unit, Daily exercise (min).

Method: A common baseline is about 35 ml per kilogram of body weight, with extra added for exercise. Needs also rise with heat, altitude, illness, and pregnancy.

## Protein Intake Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/protein-intake-calculator

Daily protein grams matched to your weight and goal.

Search focus: protein calculator; protein intake calculator; daily protein needs
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Weight, Weight unit, Goal.

Method: Targets scale with body weight: about 0.8 g/kg for sedentary up to 1.8 to 2.2 g/kg for muscle building, based on common sports-nutrition ranges. Spreading intake across meals aids absorption.

## Body Surface Area (BSA) Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/bsa-calculator

Body surface area by the Mosteller and Du Bois formulas.

Search focus: bsa calculator; body surface area calculator; mosteller formula
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Height, Height unit, Weight, Weight unit.

Method: Mosteller: BSA = sqrt(height_cm x weight_kg / 3600). Du Bois uses a power-law fit. BSA is used to normalize medication doses and physiological measurements across body sizes.

## Waist-to-Hip Ratio Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator

Your waist-to-hip ratio and its health-risk category.

Search focus: waist to hip ratio calculator; whr calculator; body shape calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Sex, Waist circumference, Hip circumference.

Method: The ratio is simply waist circumference divided by hip circumference (use the same units for both). Risk thresholds differ for men and women, and the tool applies the appropriate category.

## Smoking Cost Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/health/smoking-cost-calculator

See what smoking costs per day, month, year, and decade.

Search focus: smoking cost calculator; cost of smoking calculator; save money quit smoking
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Cigarettes per day, Price per pack ($), Cigarettes per pack.

Method: Daily cost = (cigarettes per day / pack size) x price per pack. The tool then projects that across a month, a year, and ten years to show the cumulative total.

## Percentage Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/percentage-calculator

Percent of a number, percent one number is of another, and percent change.

Search focus: percentage calculator; percent calculator; percent change; calculate percentage
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Question, A, B.

Method: X% of Y = (X÷100)·Y. "A is what % of B" = (A÷B)·100. Percent change = (new − old) ÷ |old| × 100, which is why a fall from 200 to 150 is −25%.

## Fraction Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/fraction-calculator

Add, subtract, multiply, or divide fractions — auto-simplified.

Search focus: fraction calculator; adding fractions calculator; divide fractions; simplify fraction
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: First numerator, First denominator, Operation, Second numerator, Second denominator.

Method: Addition and subtraction cross-multiply to a common denominator; multiplication multiplies straight across; division multiplies by the reciprocal. The result is simplified using the greatest common divisor.

## Average Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/average-calculator

Mean, median, mode, standard deviation, sum and count from any list.

Search focus: average calculator; mean median mode calculator; calculate mean online
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Numbers (comma or space separated).

Method: Mean is the sum divided by count. Median is the middle of the sorted list (average of the two middles when even). Mode is the most frequent value. Standard deviation here is population (÷N).

## GPA Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/gpa-calculator

Weighted GPA on the 4.0 scale from your grades and credit hours.

Search focus: gpa calculator; college gpa calculator; high school gpa; grade calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: One course per line: grade, credits.

Method: Each grade maps to points (A=4.0, A−=3.7, B+=3.3 …). GPA = Σ(points × credits) ÷ Σ(credits) — a 4-credit course moves the average more than a 2-credit one.

## Final Grade Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/final-grade-calculator

"What do I need on the final?" — answered in one calculation.

Search focus: final grade calculator; what do I need on my final; target grade calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Current grade (%), Grade you want (%), Final exam weight (%).

Method: Required = (desired − current × (1 − w)) ÷ w, where w is the final's weight as a decimal. If the answer exceeds 100%, the tool says so honestly instead of pretending it's possible.

## Quadratic Formula Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/quadratic-formula-calculator

Roots of ax² + bx + c = 0 — real or complex — with the discriminant.

Search focus: quadratic formula calculator; quadratic equation solver; solve for x
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: a, b, c.

Method: x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac)) ÷ 2a. The discriminant b² − 4ac decides everything: positive → two real roots, zero → one repeated root, negative → a complex conjugate pair.

## LCM & GCF Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/lcm-calculator

Least common multiple and greatest common factor of any numbers.

Search focus: lcm calculator; gcf calculator; hcf calculator; least common multiple
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Whole numbers (comma or space separated).

Method: GCF uses Euclid's algorithm — repeatedly replacing the larger number with the remainder. LCM of a pair = a×b ÷ GCF(a,b), folded across the whole list.

## Square Root Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/square-root-calculator

The square root of any number — including negative inputs.

Search focus: square root calculator; sqrt calculator; square root online
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Number.

Method: The principal square root of n is the non-negative value that squares back to n. For negative n, the result is imaginary: √(−n)·i — the tool labels it clearly.

## Standard Deviation Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/standard-deviation-calculator

Sample and population standard deviation, variance, and mean.

Search focus: standard deviation calculator; variance calculator; statistics calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Numbers (comma or space separated).

Method: Variance is the average squared distance from the mean; standard deviation is its square root. Sample variance divides by n-1 (Bessel's correction), population by n.

## Ratio Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/ratio-calculator

Search focus: ratio calculator; simplify ratio calculator; solve proportion
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: First term (A), Second term (B), Solve A:B = C:? (optional).

Method: Ratios simplify by dividing both terms by their greatest common divisor. To solve A:B = C:?, the tool cross-multiplies: the missing term equals C x B / A.

## Slope Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/slope-calculator

Slope, y-intercept, and the line equation from two points.

Search focus: slope calculator; slope of a line calculator; y intercept calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: x1, y1, x2, y2.

Method: Slope m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) — rise over run. The y-intercept b comes from y = mx + b, giving the complete equation. A vertical line (x1 = x2) has undefined slope.

## Combination & Permutation Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/math/combination-calculator

Compute nCr and nPr for counting problems.

Search focus: combination calculator; permutation calculator; ncr npr; probability counter
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: n (total items), r (chosen items).

Method: Permutations nPr = n! / (n-r)!. Combinations nCr = n! / (r! (n-r)!). The difference: permutations count arrangements, combinations count selections.

## Triangle Area Calculator

## Remove Line Breaks

Strip or replace line breaks — with a paragraph-preserving mode.

Search focus: remove line breaks; remove line breaks online; strip returns; clean pdf text
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: "Replace with spaces" joins all lines. "Keep paragraphs" joins single breaks but preserves blank-line paragraph separations — usually what PDF cleanup needs.

## Slug Generator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/text/slug-generator

Clean, SEO-friendly URL slugs from any title.

Search focus: slug generator; url slug generator; create url slug; seo slug maker
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: The text is Unicode-normalized (é → e), lowercased, and every non-alphanumeric run collapses to a single hyphen with edges trimmed — the convention every major CMS follows.

## Text Repeater

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/text/text-repeater

Repeat any text 5×, 10×, 25×, or 100× instantly.

Search focus: text repeater; repeat text generator; duplicate text
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: The text is repeated the chosen number of times and joined with line breaks. A size guard caps output at 500k characters to keep your browser responsive.

## Title Case Converter

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/text/title-case-converter

Headline-style capitalization with AP-style small-word rules.

Search focus: title case converter; capitalize my title; headline capitalization; ap style converter
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: Implements the AP-style convention with a 20-word small-words list. First and last words always capitalize regardless of the list, per every major style guide.

Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: Paragraphs are assembled from the canonical lorem word pool with varied sentence lengths, deterministic per page load so the layout you tested is the layout you saw.

## Find and Replace Text

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/text/find-and-replace

Bulk find and replace in any text, with regex and case options.

Search focus: find and replace online; text replace tool; regex replace; bulk replace text
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: Plain mode escapes your search term and replaces all matches; regex mode treats it as a pattern. A live counter shows how many replacements were made before you copy the result.

## Text Compare

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/text/text-compare

Spot the differences between two blocks of text.

Search focus: text compare; compare two texts; text difference checker; online diff tool
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: A longest-common-subsequence diff identifies the minimal additions and deletions between the two versions, marking added lines green and removed lines red.

## Readability Checker

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/text/readability-checker

Flesch reading ease and grade level for your writing.

Search focus: readability checker; flesch reading ease; readability score; reading level calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: The scores use sentence length and syllables per word: longer sentences and longer words lower the ease score and raise the grade level. Aim for ease above 60 (plain English) for general audiences.

## Remove Duplicate Lines

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/text/remove-duplicate-lines

Delete repeated lines from a list, keeping the first of each.

Search focus: remove duplicate lines; delete duplicate lines online; strip duplicates
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: Each line is compared against the ones already seen; duplicates are dropped while original order is preserved. Case-insensitive mode treats "Apple" and "apple" as the same.

## Remove Extra Spaces

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/text/remove-extra-spaces

Collapse double spaces, trim lines, or strip all whitespace.

Search focus: remove extra spaces; remove whitespace online; trim spaces; remove double spaces
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: "Collapse" reduces runs of spaces to one and trims trailing whitespace; "trim each line" removes leading and trailing spaces per line; "remove all" strips every whitespace character.

## Text to Binary Converter

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/text/text-to-binary

Convert text to 8-bit binary and back.

Search focus: text to binary; binary to text converter; binary translator; english to binary
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: Each character becomes its 8-bit code (based on its character code), space-separated. Decoding reverses it: each binary byte maps back to a character.

## Keyword Density Checker

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/text/keyword-density-checker

Top keywords and their density percentage in your text.

Search focus: keyword density checker; keyword density tool; word frequency counter; seo keyword analyzer
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: The tool counts each word, divides by the total word count for density, and ranks the top terms. Common stop words (the, a, and…) can be filtered so meaningful keywords surface.

## JSON Formatter & Validator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/json-formatter

Format, validate, and minify JSON with precise error messages.

Search focus: json formatter; json validator; json beautifier; format json online
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: The native JSON.parse does the validation (the same parser your runtime uses), so what passes here passes in production. Formatting re-serializes with 2-space indentation; minify strips all insignificant whitespace.

## Base64 Encode / Decode

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/base64-encode-decode

UTF-8-safe Base64 encoding and decoding in the browser.

Search focus: base64 decode; base64 encode; base64 converter; decode base64 online
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: Text is first encoded to UTF-8 bytes (TextEncoder), then Base64-encoded — the order that makes Unicode survive. Decoding reverses it: Base64 → bytes → UTF-8 text, with clear errors for invalid input.

## URL Encode / Decode

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/url-encode-decode

Percent-encode text for URLs, or decode %20s back to readable text.

Search focus: url encode; url decoder; percent encoding; url encode online
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: Uses encodeURIComponent/decodeURIComponent — the component-level functions that encode every reserved character, correct for query-string values. Invalid percent sequences produce a clear error instead of silent corruption.

## UUID Generator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/uuid-generator

Cryptographically random UUID v4s, singly or in bulk.

Search focus: uuid generator; guid generator; uuid v4; generate uuid
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: Uses crypto.randomUUID(), the platform implementation of RFC 4122 v4: 122 random bits from a CSPRNG, formatted as the familiar 8-4-4-4-12 hex string.

## Hash Generator (SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-1)

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/hash-generator

SHA hashes of any text, computed locally with Web Crypto.

Search focus: sha256 hash generator; hash generator; sha512 online; sha1 calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: The text is UTF-8 encoded and passed to crypto.subtle.digest; the result renders as lowercase hex. The same input always yields the same hash; even a one-character change produces a completely different digest.

## Password Generator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/password-generator

Strong random passwords from a cryptographic source — never sent anywhere.

Search focus: password generator; strong password generator; random password; secure password
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: Characters are drawn with crypto.getRandomValues using rejection sampling — the technique that avoids the subtle bias of the naive modulo approach. At 16 characters with all sets enabled, the space exceeds 10³¹ possibilities.

## Color Converter (HEX ⇄ RGB ⇄ HSL)

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/color-converter

Convert colors between HEX, RGB, and HSL with a live swatch.

Search focus: hex to rgb; color converter; rgb to hex; hsl converter
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: HEX pairs are parsed to 0–255 RGB channels. HSL derives from RGB via max/min channel math: hue is the angle on the color wheel, saturation the colorfulness, lightness the brightness.

## Unix Timestamp Converter

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/unix-timestamp-converter

Epoch seconds/milliseconds to human dates and back — with live now.

Search focus: unix timestamp converter; epoch converter; timestamp to date; unix epoch
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: Seconds × 1000 feed JavaScript's Date; the tool auto-detects milliseconds by magnitude (13-digit values). Output shows UTC, your local time, and ISO 8601 — the three formats that cover real work.

## Regex Tester

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/regex-tester

Test regular expressions live with match highlighting and flags.

Search focus: regex tester; regular expression tester; regex online; test regex
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: The tool builds a JavaScript RegExp from your pattern and flags and collects all matches. Flags: g (global), i (ignore case), m (multiline anchors), s (dot matches newlines). Invalid patterns show the engine's error.

## JWT Decoder

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/jwt-decoder

Decode and inspect JWT header, payload, and expiry — locally.

Search focus: jwt decoder; decode jwt; jwt parser; jwt checker
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: A JWT is three base64url-encoded parts separated by dots: header.payload.signature. The tool decodes the first two to JSON and reads the exp claim to show the expiry. It does not verify the signature.

## CSV to JSON Converter

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/csv-to-json

Convert CSV to JSON and JSON to CSV, both directions.

Search focus: csv to json; json to csv; csv json converter; convert csv
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: CSV parsing respects double-quoted fields (so commas and quotes inside values survive) and uses the first row as keys. JSON-to-CSV collects all object keys as the header row and escapes any value containing commas, quotes, or newlines.

## Diff Checker

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/diff-checker

Compare two texts and highlight added and removed lines.

Search focus: diff checker; text diff; compare text online; code difference
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: A longest-common-subsequence algorithm finds the minimal set of line additions and deletions that turns the original into the changed version — the same core technique behind version-control diffs.

## HTML Encode / Decode

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/html-encode-decode

Escape HTML special characters, or decode entities back.

Search focus: html encode; html decode; html entity encoder; escape html online
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: Encoding replaces the five reserved characters — & < > " ' — with entities like &amp; and &lt;. Decoding reverses it. This is what prevents user input from breaking or injecting into a page.

## IP Subnet Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/ip-subnet-calculator

Calculate network address, broadcast, host range, and mask from CIDR.

Search focus: ip subnet calculator; cidr calculator; subnet mask calculator; network calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: IPv4 address, CIDR prefix (/0–/32).

Method: The CIDR prefix defines how many bits are the network portion. The tool applies the subnet mask with bitwise operations to derive the network and broadcast addresses, then counts the usable hosts between them.

## Aspect Ratio Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/aspect-ratio-calculator

Simplify width:height to a ratio and scale dimensions proportionally.

Search focus: aspect ratio calculator; ratio calculator; image dimension calculator; resize ratio calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Original width, Original height, New width (optional — solves height), New height (optional — solves width).

Method: The ratio is found by dividing both dimensions by their greatest common divisor (GCD). To scale, the tool multiplies by the decimal ratio so the new dimensions keep the same proportions.

Search focus: css specificity calculator; specificity calculator; css selector specificity; css priority calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: Specificity is counted in three groups: IDs (a), classes/attributes/pseudo-classes (b), and elements/pseudo-elements (c). Higher groups always win — a single ID beats any number of classes.

## Password Strength Checker

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/password-strength-checker

Estimate password entropy, crack time, and weaknesses.

Search focus: password strength checker; password strength test; how strong is my password
Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: The checker measures the character pool and length to estimate entropy in bits, then flags common patterns: short length, single character types, repeats, keyboard sequences, and known weak words. Crack time assumes a fast offline attack of about 10 billion guesses per second.

## Concrete Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/construction/concrete-calculator

Cubic yards of concrete and number of bags for any slab or footing.

Search focus: concrete calculator; how much concrete do i need; concrete yardage calculator; concrete bags calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Length (ft), Width (ft), Depth (inches) (in).

Method: Volume = length x width x (depth in feet). Convert to cubic yards by dividing by 27. A 60 lb bag covers ~0.45 cu ft; an 80 lb bag ~0.60 cu ft.

## Paint Calculator

Method: Wall area = 2 x (length + width) x height, minus 20 sq ft per door and 15 sq ft per window. Divide by 350 sq ft per gallon, then multiply by coats.

## Flooring Calculator

Method: Flooring needed = room area x (1 + waste%). Divide by box coverage to get box count. Use 10% waste for straight install, 15% for diagonal or herringbone.

## Roof Pitch Calculator

Method: Pitch = rise:12. Angle = arctan(rise/run) in degrees. Area multiplier = sqrt(1 + (rise/run)^2). Multiply your plan area by this factor for the true roof surface.

## Staircase Calculator

Method: Steps = round(total rise / target riser). Actual riser = total rise / steps. Total run = steps x tread depth. Ideal angle is 30-45 degrees.

## Ohm's Law Calculator

Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: Ohm's Law: V = I × R. Enter any two values and leave the third blank. Power P = V × I is always calculated from the result. Default example: 120 V across 10 Ω draws 12 A and 1,440 W.

## Resistor Color Code Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/science/resistor-color-code-calculator

Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Band 1 (1st digit), Band 2 (2nd digit), Band 3 (multiplier), Band 4 (tolerance).

Method: Bands 1 and 2 give the first two digits; band 3 is the multiplier (power of 10); band 4 is tolerance. Value = (10×d1 + d2) × 10^multiplier.

## Voltage Divider Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/science/voltage-divider-calculator

Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Input voltage (Vin) (V), R1 (top resistor) (Ω), R2 (bottom resistor) (Ω).

Method: Vout = Vin × R2 / (R1 + R2). Current = Vin / (R1 + R2). Power = Vin × I. The output is taken across R2.

## Torque Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/science/torque-calculator

Method: Torque (τ) = Force (F) × Moment arm (r). SI unit is N·m. The moment arm is the perpendicular distance from the line of action of the force to the rotation axis.

## pH Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/science/ph-calculator

H⁺ concentration, pOH, and classification from a pH value.

Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: pH value.

Method: [H⁺] = 10^(-pH). pOH = 14 - pH. [OH⁻] = 10^(-pOH). pH below 7 is acidic; above 7 is alkaline; exactly 7 is neutral (pure water at 25°C).

## Half-Life Calculator

Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Initial amount, Half-life (time units), Time elapsed (same units).

Method: Remaining = initial × (0.5)^(time / half-life). The units of time and half-life must match (both in years, days, seconds, etc.).

## Z-Score Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/statistics/z-score-calculator

Z-score, percentile, and probability from a value, mean, and standard deviation.

Search focus: z-score calculator; z score calculator; standard score calculator; percentile from z-score
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Value (x), Mean (μ), Standard deviation (σ).

Method: Z = (x − μ) / σ. The z-score measures how many standard deviations a value is from the mean. The percentile is derived from the standard normal cumulative distribution.

## Confidence Interval Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/statistics/confidence-interval-calculator

Confidence interval and margin of error from sample statistics.

Search focus: confidence interval calculator; margin of error calculator; ci calculator; 95 confidence interval
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Sample mean, Standard deviation, Sample size, Confidence level.

Method: CI = mean ± (z × standard error), where standard error = sd / √n. The z-critical value depends on the confidence level (1.96 for 95%).

## Sample Size Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/statistics/sample-size-calculator

Required sample size for a survey at a given confidence and margin of error.

Search focus: sample size calculator; survey sample size; statistical sample size calculator; how many respondents do i need
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Confidence level, Margin of error (%) (%), Expected proportion (%) (%).

Method: n = (z² × p × (1−p)) / margin². Use p = 50% for the most conservative (largest) sample size when you have no prior estimate of the proportion.

## Correlation Coefficient Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/statistics/correlation-coefficient-calculator

Pearson correlation coefficient (r) and R² from two data lists.

Search focus: correlation coefficient calculator; pearson r calculator; correlation calculator; r value calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: X values (comma or space separated), Y values (comma or space separated).

Method: Pearson r measures the linear relationship between two variables, ranging from −1 (perfect negative) to +1 (perfect positive). R² is r squared — the proportion of variance explained.

## P-Value Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/statistics/p-value-calculator

P-value and significance from a z-statistic (one- or two-tailed).

Search focus: p-value calculator; p value from z score; statistical significance calculator; hypothesis test calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Z-statistic, Test type.

Method: The p-value is the probability of observing a result as extreme as yours if the null hypothesis were true. It is derived from the standard normal distribution based on your z-statistic and test direction.

## CAC Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/business/cac-calculator

Search focus: cac calculator; customer acquisition cost calculator; ltv cac ratio; marketing cost calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Total sales & marketing spend ($), New customers acquired, Customer lifetime value (optional) ($).

Method: CAC = total sales and marketing spend ÷ new customers acquired. The LTV:CAC ratio divides lifetime value by CAC — a ratio of 3:1 or higher is generally considered healthy.

## Customer Lifetime Value Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/business/customer-lifetime-value-calculator

Customer lifetime value (LTV) from purchase value, frequency, and lifespan.

Search focus: customer lifetime value calculator; ltv calculator; clv calculator; lifetime value calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Average purchase value ($), Purchases per year, Customer lifespan (years), Gross margin (%) (%).

Method: LTV = average purchase value × purchase frequency × customer lifespan. Applying your gross margin gives the profit-based LTV, which is more meaningful for unit economics.

## ROAS Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/business/roas-calculator

Return on ad spend, net profit, and break-even ROAS.

Search focus: roas calculator; return on ad spend calculator; advertising roi calculator; roas formula
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Revenue from ads ($), Ad spend ($), Cost of goods sold (optional) ($).

Method: ROAS = revenue ÷ ad spend, expressed as a ratio. Break-even ROAS accounts for product cost (COGS): you need revenue to cover both ad spend and the cost of goods sold.

## Email Marketing ROI Calculator

Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Email list size, Open rate (%) (%), Click-through rate (%) (%), Conversion rate (%) (%), Average order value ($), Cost per email ($).

Method: Revenue = list × open rate × click rate × conversion rate × average order value. ROI = (revenue − cost) ÷ cost. Email consistently delivers one of the highest ROIs in marketing.

## Employee Turnover Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/business/employee-turnover-calculator

Search focus: employee turnover calculator; turnover rate calculator; staff turnover calculator; attrition rate calculator
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Employees who left, Average number of employees, Average annual salary ($).

Method: Turnover rate = (employees who left ÷ average headcount) × 100. Replacement cost is estimated at roughly 50% of annual salary, covering recruiting, onboarding, and lost productivity.

## Gross Margin Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/business/gross-margin-calculator

Gross margin, gross profit, and markup from revenue and cost.

Search focus: gross margin calculator; profit margin calculator; markup calculator; margin vs markup
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Revenue / selling price ($), Cost of goods sold ($).

Method: Gross margin = (revenue − COGS) ÷ revenue. Markup = (revenue − COGS) ÷ COGS. They describe the same profit but from different bases, which is why they differ.

## Download Time Calculator

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/developer/download-time-calculator

Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: File size, File size unit, Transfer speed, Speed unit.

Method: Transfer time in seconds equals file size in bits divided by transfer speed in bits per second. A byte contains 8 bits, so 100 Mbps equals 12.5 MB/s. GB uses powers of 1,000 and GiB uses powers of 1,024.

Method: With square pixels, the pixel diagonal equals the square root of width² + height². Divide it by the physical diagonal in inches for PPI. Pixel pitch in millimeters equals 25.4 divided by PPI.

## Battery Life Calculator

Method: Estimated runtime in hours equals capacity in mAh × usable percentage ÷ 100 ÷ average battery-side current in mA. The result is a charge-budget estimate. Age, temperature, voltage cutoffs, and discharge rate affect usable capacity.

## EMI Calculator (India)

URL: https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/emi-calculator

Calculate a fixed-rate loan EMI in rupees with total interest and repayment.

Search focus: emi calculator (india); india calculator; INR
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Loan amount (₹), Annual interest rate (%), Loan term (months).

Method: EMI = P × r / (1 − (1+r)^−n), using monthly decimal rate r and number of months n. At 0%, EMI is principal divided by months. Fees and floating-rate resets are excluded.

Search focus: sip calculator (india); india calculator; INR
Processing: runs locally in the browser
Inputs: Monthly contribution (₹), Assumed annual nominal return (%), Years, Deposit timing.

Method: The future value of monthly deposits is C × ((1+r)^n − 1) / r. Beginning-of-month deposits multiply this by (1+r). Return is an assumption, not a mutual-fund forecast; taxes and charges are excluded.

## FD Calculator — Deposit Maturity

Processing: runs locally in the browser

Method: Maturity = principal × (1 + annual rate / compounding frequency)^(frequency × years). This models a cumulative deposit without withdrawals. Bank day counts, payout options, premature closure and TDS can differ.
